name: Terrarium 45x35x80
label: Large terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 45x35x80 cm with a handmade 3D background. Volume: 126.0 liters, vertical format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: A height of 80 cm on a 45x35 cm base gives about 126 liters in a distinctly vertical format. The back has a 3D background, which at this height forms a large climbing wall. The base is small, so the terrarium takes up little room on the floor or on a low cabinet.

Over 80 cm of height, temperature and humidity stratify naturally: it is warmer and drier near the top and damper near the bottom. Crested and gargoyle geckos move through that whole range, so place branches on at least three levels. Day geckos and green anoles bask high up, under the lamp. Tree frogs do well with broad leaves in the middle section.

The 45x40x70 model has a similar volume with a wider floor and 10 cm less height. With tall terrariums, tell us which species you keep, because of the placement of the ventilation openings. The lead time for a custom build is 7 to 14 days. You choose the film for the sides from 34 patterns, and the shape of the background between rock and bark.
